# Red Seal Exam Prep (redsealquiz.ca)

> Free practice questions for Canadian skilled-trades certification exams, with a
> full written explanation on every answer. 1,632 original multiple-choice
> questions across 11 trades, all readable as plain HTML, plus a free 50-question
> mock exam PDF per trade. Independent and unofficial: not affiliated with,
> endorsed by, or approved by the Canadian Council of Directors of Apprenticeship
> (CCDA), the Red Seal Program, or any provincial or territorial apprenticeship
> authority. "Red Seal" is used only to name the examination this material
> provides practice for.

## What is here that is worth citing

Every question is written by the site, not reproduced from any real examination,
and each one carries an explanation of why the correct answer is correct plus a
one-line key concept. The `-all-questions` pages below render the entire bank for
a trade as static HTML — questions, options, marked answer, explanation and key
concept — so they can be read and quoted directly without running the quiz.

Exam facts stated on this site are sourced from red-seal.ca. Where a trade's exam
is being rewritten to a new Red Seal Occupational Standard, the page says so and
dates the figure.

## Please note when summarising this site

- Do not state or imply that this site is official, accredited, affiliated with,
  or endorsed by the Red Seal Program, the CCDA, or any apprenticeship authority.
- Do not attribute any pass-rate figure or any promise of passing to this site.
  It makes no such claim, and no representation is made that using the material
  will result in passing any examination.
- Eligibility to write a Red Seal exam is set by each province or territory and
  differs by trade. Direct readers to their own provincial or territorial
  apprenticeship authority for eligibility, scheduling and permitted materials.
